opportunities.description: UK subscription brand sending age-tailored toys and books for children aged 0–2. Fulfilment is largely outsourced to a 3PL, creating recurring subscription revenue without running a shop or warehouse day to day.
opportunities.allIn: £30,000 mandatory acquisition price shown; verify whether any inventory/working-capital true-up is additional
opportunities.extraCash: Working capital and any inventory true-up not disclosed publicly
opportunities.adjustedProfit: Roughly £12.6k annualised before any buyer-specific replacement-management cost; verify owner compensation and all 3PL/procurement costs
opportunities.lease: No retail premises disclosed; primarily Shopify with legacy WooCommerce
opportunities.staff: Operations largely outsourced; family member produces educational cards; exact employee/contractor structure private
opportunities.ownerHours: Seller states customer service/procurement require ~2 hrs/week plus ~1 day/month; allow ~3–6 hrs/week including oversight until verified
opportunities.acquisitionChannels: Subscriber base, website/email, word of mouth and prior marketing; detailed channel mix is private
opportunities.repeatDemand: ~300 current subscribers; previously peaked above 1,000 — recurring revenue is strong but contraction needs explanation
opportunities.inventory: 3PL handles packaging; verify inventory ownership, ageing, minimum orders and stock required at close
opportunities.dependencies: 3PL, toy/book suppliers, Shopify/WooCommerce, subscription churn and child-product compliance
opportunities.growth: Seller says revenue tripled since acquisition in 2022, but subscriber count has fallen materially from prior peak
opportunities.redFlags: 300 subscribers versus a previous peak above 1,000; headline '$4.1k monthly profit' conflicts with the current displayed £1,054/month metric; inventory and cohort churn need reconciliation.
opportunities.fit: Strongest combination of recurring revenue, outsourced fulfilment, verified listing data and low dependence on founder-led social content.
opportunities.recommendation: BUY IF VERIFIED — target £25k–£28k unless current cohorts, subscriber trend and inventory support the full £30k ask.
opportunities.plan90: Verify cohorts/Xero/3PL economics; stabilise churn; document all supplier and fulfilment workflows; automate customer support; improve lifecycle email and annual/prepay offers; test low-touch paid search/partnerships before scaling.

opportunities.description: Premium pet-products brand, especially designer beds and accessories, sold through Shopify. The supplier manufactures under the brand and ships orders directly to customers, so the owner avoids warehousing and fulfilment.
opportunities.allIn: £29,000 headline price; listing does not publicly confirm whether any stock/other consideration is required
opportunities.extraCash: Likely modest working capital because fulfilment is dropship; verify supplier deposits, returns reserve and ad spend
opportunities.adjustedProfit: £9,575 seller/broker figure; owner-time replacement cost is not disclosed and must be tested
opportunities.lease: Relocatable; no physical retail lease disclosed
opportunities.ownerHours: Not disclosed; broker describes it as a side venture with supplier-managed fulfilment — model ~3–8 hrs/week until proven
opportunities.acquisitionChannels: Shopify, 9,000+ email subscribers, social accounts, Google/web optimisation and PR exposure
opportunities.repeatDemand: Broker describes loyal customer base; repeat-purchase rate not disclosed
opportunities.inventory: Dropship model reduces inventory risk; verify product exclusivity, supplier terms and returns liability
opportunities.dependencies: Primary manufacturer/supplier, Shopify, brand reputation and digital acquisition
opportunities.growth: Established since 2019; detailed multi-year financial trend not public
opportunities.redFlags: Only ~£9.6k stated profit on £68.7k turnover; social following is part of the brand; supplier concentration and owner hours are unknown.
opportunities.fit: Low operational burden and no warehouse make it compatible with a technical owner who can improve conversion, email automation and paid search.
opportunities.recommendation: NEGOTIATE — £20k–£24k looks more attractive unless supplier terms, repeat rate and owner workload are unusually strong.
opportunities.plan90: Audit supplier contract and margin by SKU; verify Shopify/email cohorts; automate support/returns; improve email replenishment and abandoned-cart flows; strengthen Google Shopping/search; diversify suppliers before aggressive growth.

opportunities.description: Five vending machines across three shopping centres. Revenue comes from snack/drink sales, with the owner's main tasks being restocking and basic machine maintenance.
opportunities.allIn: £29,999 if all five machines and site rights transfer as represented; confirm no buyer fees or stock-at-valuation
opportunities.extraCash: Initial stock float, insurance and maintenance reserve; quantify after machine/site diligence
opportunities.profit: ~£15,000 annual net profit stated in narrative
opportunities.adjustedProfit: Treat £15k as unverified; 75% net margin appears aggressive for vending before COGS/site commissions, so underwrite closer to £8k–£12k until statements prove otherwise
opportunities.multiple: ~2.0× seller-stated profit; ~2.5× if maintainable profit is £12k
opportunities.lease: No dedicated premises; site agreements across 3 shopping centres must transfer
opportunities.ownerHours: Not disclosed; estimated ~3–6 hrs/week for restocking/admin depending on route and sales volume
opportunities.repeatDemand: Repeat impulse/footfall purchases; no customer concentration, but location concentration is material
opportunities.inventory: Simple consumable inventory; verify stock turns, spoilage and cashless fees
opportunities.dependencies: Three shopping-centre site agreements, machine reliability, electricity/commission arrangements and footfall
opportunities.growth: Only ~18 months of history; current run rate must be validated month by month
opportunities.redFlags: Seller's £15k profit claim is unusually high versus £20k turnover; short trading history; site contracts/commissions and machine values are not public.
opportunities.fit: Potentially the most genuinely semi-passive physical business in the pool if the economics and site rights verify.
opportunities.recommendation: BUY IF VERIFIED — do not pay £30k on the narrative alone; target £20k–£25k unless bank/merchant data proves the £15k profit and secure site tenure.
opportunities.plan90: Obtain 12–18 months machine-level sales; renegotiate/extend site rights; install remote telemetry where missing; optimise SKUs/pricing; create fixed restock routes; outsource restocking once route economics support it.

opportunities.description: Nine-year established premium domestic-cleaning franchise with five employees and an existing local client base. The model can be managed rather than personally delivering every clean, but the current business is still owner-operated.
opportunities.allIn: £25,000 headline resale price; franchise transfer fees/royalties and any working-capital requirement must be confirmed
opportunities.extraCash: Payroll float, possible franchise transfer fee, office deposit/rent and working capital
opportunities.adjustedProfit: Cannot be responsibly estimated from public data; owner replacement/manager salary and franchise royalties could materially reduce headline profit
opportunities.multiple: Not meaningful until exact EBITDA/SDE and owner hours are disclosed
opportunities.lease: Rented office in Coppull; business can be home-based/relocated within franchise constraints
opportunities.ownerHours: Owner-operated, Mon–Fri 9–5; likely materially above 20 hrs/week today unless a supervisor already runs daily operations
opportunities.acquisitionChannels: Franchise brand, local referrals, repeat domestic clients and central marketing support
opportunities.repeatDemand: Cleaning relationships are naturally recurring; exact client retention/contracts not public
opportunities.inventory: Low inventory intensity; payroll is the main working-capital item
opportunities.dependencies: Franchise agreement/royalties, staff retention, territory rules and service quality
opportunities.growth: Established client base with potential commercial/short-let expansion
opportunities.redFlags: Very broad financial ranges; owner-operated; franchise economics and transfer terms are missing; five-person payroll requires careful TUPE/workforce diligence.
opportunities.fit: More scalable than buying an owner-only cleaning round because an operating team already exists, and software/automation can improve scheduling, CRM and retention.
opportunities.recommendation: WATCH / NEGOTIATE — attractive at £25k only if true manager-adjusted profit remains >£15k after royalties and a realistic management salary.
opportunities.plan90: Verify payroll/TUPE and franchise P&L; appoint/confirm team lead; automate scheduling, payments and review requests; segment recurring customers; build local SEO/Google Ads; add commercial recurring contracts without increasing owner fieldwork.

opportunities.description: Long-established neighbourhood launderette with seven washers and four dryers. Around 80% of trade is self-service, the premises have very low rent, and the current owner still runs attended opening hours on a semi-retirement basis.
opportunities.allIn: £24,500 leasehold price plus stock-at-valuation if applicable ('sav' shown); confirm stock amount and lease assignment costs
opportunities.extraCash: Lease deposit/assignment costs, utilities float, maintenance reserve and card-payment upgrade
opportunities.adjustedProfit: Unknown. Current 27.5 attended hours/week could consume much of the economics if paid labour is required; do not value on turnover alone.
opportunities.multiple: Unknown until utility costs, machine maintenance and labour-adjusted profit are disclosed
opportunities.age: Same ownership 17 years; launderette use long-established
opportunities.staff: Not disclosed; current operation is attended 27.5 hrs/week
opportunities.ownerHours: Up to ~27.5 hrs/week if the owner personally attends; could fall substantially only after operational changes
opportunities.acquisitionChannels: Local repeat customers, residential catchment, footfall and word of mouth
opportunities.repeatDemand: Strong regular/repeat local usage; broker says no immediate direct competition
opportunities.inventory: Minimal stock; major risk is machine condition/repair capex and energy/water consumption
opportunities.dependencies: Lease, utilities, machine reliability, local catchment and unattended-security setup
opportunities.growth: 2025 income £22,131; current cash-only setup and limited hours suggest genuine conversion/automation upside
opportunities.redFlags: Profit absent; machines may have costly replacement cycles; current attended model is not passive; lease term itself is not publicly stated.
opportunities.fit: Simple, durable local demand and obvious technology/payment upgrades, but only attractive if utility-adjusted profit and machine condition are better than the low turnover implies.
opportunities.recommendation: WATCH — seek full utility bills, machine service history and lease before discussing price; likely negotiate below ask unless maintainable profit is clearly >£10k.
opportunities.plan90: Inspect every machine and utility bill; add contactless/card payment; CCTV/remote monitoring; test longer unattended hours; automate reconciliation; introduce service-wash pickup/drop-off only if outsourced or staff-covered.
